answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The orchard of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Each submission hangs on the walnut of a task receipt, and the juniper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter.
